title: Enable “Add” dialog entry points and make all dialog/popover surfaces fully opaque

requirements.summary: Enable any disabled “Add” tab/trigger in dialog-driven workflows so the add/create form can always be opened.
acceptanceCriteria: In every dialog or dialog-driven workflow where an “Add” tab/trigger exists, it is not disabled and can be selected/clicked.
Selecting the “Add” tab/trigger reliably reveals the add/create form content (no hidden/blocked state).
No console errors occur when switching to the “Add” tab/trigger.

file_operations.description: Audit dialog-driven UI within the client detail workflow for any Tabs triggers/segments/buttons labeled “Add” that are disabled; remove the disabled state and ensure selecting it reveals the intended add/create form content without errors.

Audit the client add/edit dialog for any disabled “Add” entry points (e.g., tab triggers or segmented controls inside the dialog); ensure “Add” is enabled and that the create form is visible when selected.
Audit the product create/edit dialog for any disabled “Add” tab/trigger patterns; enable “Add” selection/click and ensure it reliably shows the create form content.
Audit the quotation creation dialog for any disabled “Add” entry points (tabs/segments/buttons labeled “Add”); ensure they are enabled and correctly reveal the create form content.
Audit the quotation detail dialog for any disabled “Add” tab/trigger (including nested dialog-driven actions); enable it and ensure the add/create content renders correctly when selected.

Audit the company settings dialog for any disabled “Add” entry points (e.g., adding address blocks, adding logo, adding records) and ensure “Add” triggers are enabled and reveal the intended form sections without console errors.
Audit the user management dialog for any disabled “Add” entry points (e.g., add user/add role flows); ensure “Add” triggers are enabled and reveal the correct content/state reliably.

Audit the invoice print preview dialog workflow for any disabled “Add” tab/trigger patterns (including nested popovers/dialogs); ensure “Add” is enabled and that selecting it reveals the intended create/add content without errors.
Audit the quotation print preview dialog workflow for any disabled “Add” tab/trigger patterns; enable “Add” and ensure it reliably reveals add/create form content when selected.

requirements.summary: Ensure all dialog, popover, and form container surfaces are fully opaque (no opacity modifiers or backdrop-blur) across the app, including nested select dropdown content within dialogs.
acceptanceCriteria: All dialog surfaces (DialogContent) render with fully opaque backgrounds in both light and dark modes.
No dialog/form/popover container classes include opacity modifiers (e.g., bg-*/50) or backdrop-blur/translucent effects.
Nested popovers used within dialogs (e.g., SelectContent) are also fully opaque and readable.

file_operations.description: Add/adjust global styling for dialog and popover surfaces to enforce fully opaque backgrounds and remove any backdrop-filter effects on content surfaces (while keeping within existing global styling entry points). Ensure custom classes used by dialogs (e.g., popout-surface/popout-header-accent/popout section styling) resolve to opaque theme colors in light/dark modes.

Make the dialog surface fully opaque by applying explicit opaque container classes to DialogContent. Ensure nested SelectContent uses an opaque background and border. Replace any translucent utility usage (e.g., bg-*/10) with fully opaque equivalents so the dialog and its nested popovers are readable.
Ensure all nested popover surfaces (e.g., SelectContent) and dialog content containers use fully opaque theme backgrounds without opacity modifiers or backdrop-blur styling.

Verify DialogContent and form container classes are fully opaque and do not include any Tailwind opacity modifiers or backdrop-blur/translucent effects; normalize to opaque theme background classes consistently.

Verify DialogContent, ScrollArea wrappers, and any nested popovers used in the product form are fully opaque and do not use opacity modifiers or backdrop-blur styling; normalize to opaque theme background classes.

Ensure the dialog surface classes used by this popout (e.g., popout-surface and related section containers) render fully opaque with no opacity modifiers or backdrop-blur effects, consistent in light/dark modes.
Verify the confirmation dialog surface is fully opaque and that no container utilities introduce translucency or backdrop blur; align with the app-wide opaque dialog surface convention.
Ensure DialogContent and any nested popover surfaces inside the settings form render with fully opaque backgrounds and no opacity-modified utility classes; keep consistency across light/dark modes.
